explanation: Orthogonality requires the inner product to be zero. Here, ∫₀^π cos(t)sin(2t) dt = 4/3, so I is false. Also, ∫₀^π t cos(t) dt = [t sin(t)+cos(t)]₀^π = −2, so II is false. Since the functions are not pairwise orthogonal, III is false as well.
